intro: Thurman's Sewing Kit is a small pouch containing the needles and shears required by an apprentice tailor in Stormwind City. Belonging to Thurman Schneider, it was conveniently left behind at his family's canal home in an attempt to dodge a long day of tedious tailoring work.

p: The sewing kit holds the everyday tools of an apprentice tailor: needles, shears, and thread. It belongs to young Thurman Schneider, who studies tailoring at Larson Clothiers deep in Stormwind's Mage Quarter near the Mage Tower. Knowing her son cannot perform his duties without his equipment, his mother, Rema Schneider, asks sympathetic passersby along the Canals to carry it to the shop. Thurman's reaction upon receiving it reveals that leaving his shears and needles behind was no accident, but rather a failed plot to skip out on stitching garments in favor of leisure.
